question: Should this branch be rebuilt as a Telegram-only refactor, or should maintainers intentionally review and accept the unrelated protocol, UI, dependency, provider, release-script, and automation changes as one combined landing?
rationale: The linked issue explicitly scopes the work to behavior-preserving Telegram extraction, but the current dirty branch changes many unrelated compatibility-sensitive surfaces; automation cannot safely choose which changes are intended.

options.title: Rebuild Telegram-only
options.body: Rebase or recreate the branch from current main with only the handler extraction and its focused tests, then add real Telegram smoke proof.

options.title: Review as combined landing
options.body: Keep the broad branch only if maintainers explicitly own every unrelated behavior, dependency, protocol, automation, and upgrade impact and provide corresponding proof.

options.title: Close and replace
options.body: Close this branch and open a fresh narrow PR if separating the existing history is more expensive than recreating the Telegram extraction.

recommendation.title: Rebuild Telegram-only
recommendation.body: Rebase or recreate the branch from current main with only the handler extraction and its focused tests, then add real Telegram smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person sponsored the linked refactor and has the strongest recent merged history on the central Telegram runtime boundary.
